I reported Frank’s body in Oxygen. I got there from upper engine, and Diana entered Oxygen right around the same time from upper engine too. Frank’s body was already in the room when I saw it.

I didn’t see anyone else near the body. Diana was the only person I saw around there, so I want to hear her route.

I didn't see Charlie or Diana on my side of the map recently either, which lines up with them being up top. Since Charlie reported the body and Diana was the only one he saw around there, it definitely makes her look suspicious. I want to hear Diana's explanation for being in oxygen right at that time before I cast my vote.

I was on the right/middle side most of the round: security → navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → cafeteria. I never went to Oxygen or upper engine, and I didn’t see Frank’s body or Frank alive.

I also didn’t see Charlie or Diana on my route, so I can’t confirm either of their positions. From what Charlie said, Diana being in Oxygen right as the body was found is definitely important, but it could also be bad timing if the body was already there. I’d like to hear Diana’s full route and whether anyone can back it up.

I started upper engine, went to oxygen, then back through upper engine to medbay, electrical, security, and ended in navigation. I didn’t run into anyone directly this round, but I did see Frank leave upper engine toward oxygen around tick 9, so Frank was alive then.

When I passed through oxygen early, I didn’t see a body, so the kill happened after that. I’ve been on the right side since then and can’t confirm Alice or Eve, and I didn’t see Charlie or Diana either.

Based on Charlie’s report, Diana being there at the body timing matters, but if Charlie saw her enter Oxygen at the same time and the body was already there, that doesn’t automatically make her the killer. I want Diana’s exact route and timing before deciding. Right now I don’t have enough to hard accuse, but the kill window is after Frank went into oxygen around tick 9 and before the report at 24.

My route was electrical → security → navigation → storage → lower engine → upper engine, and I was heading into Oxygen for my task when the report happened. I did **not** see Frank alive this round, and I did **not** see the body until the report screen — I arrived right as Charlie did.

Important detail: I saw Charlie multiple times before this. I saw him come from weapons into security around tick 4, then into navigation around tick 10, then storage around tick 16, and he was with/near me in lower engine around ticks 19-20. He left lower engine toward upper engine at tick 21, ahead of me.

So Charlie is correct that I was near Oxygen at the end, but he was also taking the exact same route and was slightly ahead of me going toward upper engine/Oxygen. I’m not saying that makes him definitely the duck, but I don’t like that he framed it as if I’m the only one who had opportunity when he was right there too.

Bob’s info that Frank went to Oxygen around tick 9 means the body could’ve been there for a while. I think this is too thin to vote on. My vote lean is skip unless someone has stronger evidence.

Diana’s right that we were on a similar path near the end — I’m not trying to hide that. I left lower engine ahead of her, went up to upper engine, then into Oxygen and saw Frank’s body immediately, so I reported. Diana entered Oxygen basically at the same moment, which is why I mentioned her.

But after hearing everyone, I agree it’s possible the body was older. Bob saying Frank went toward Oxygen around tick 9 is important, and if Bob was also in/near Oxygen early, then the kill window is wider than just Diana and me arriving at the end.

So my info is: I found the body in Oxygen, Diana was the only person I personally saw nearby, but I can’t say I saw her kill. I think Diana and Bob are the two most relevant to question based on timing, but I’m not 100% confident enough to hard push Diana just from her entering with me.
skip

I still have no direct info on Oxygen — my route was security → navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → cafeteria, and I didn’t see anyone along that route, so I can’t clear or accuse anyone personally.

After hearing Diana and Charlie both talk, it sounds like they were on the same path near the end, and both agree Charlie was slightly ahead and Diana arrived basically with him. That means Diana being there matters, but it also doesn’t prove she killed if the body was already there.

Bob’s info makes the timing wider: Frank went toward Oxygen around tick 9, and the body wasn’t reported until tick 24. That’s a big enough window that I don’t feel comfortable voting Diana just for arriving at the report. Charlie self-report is technically possible too, but I don’t have evidence for that either.

I’m leaning skip unless someone has a stronger contradiction. We should keep an eye on Bob/Charlie/Diana next round because they’re the only ones tied to Oxygen timing.

I agree with the skip lean here. The only solid thing I can add is still that Frank was alive at tick 9 going from upper engine into Oxygen, and I had passed Oxygen before that with no body. After that I went away to medbay/electrical/security/navigation and didn’t see anyone.

Charlie and Diana both arriving at the body together makes them relevant, but since they both agree Charlie was slightly ahead and Diana came in right as the report happened, I don’t think that alone proves Diana did it. A Charlie self-report is possible in theory, but I don’t have evidence for that either.

Alice and Eve both claim they were away from Oxygen, but nobody can really confirm them. So the window is too wide and I don’t think we should force a vote on weak info. I’m voting skip, but next round we should watch Charlie and Diana’s pathing closely, and honestly everyone should try to stay paired.

Just to restate clearly from my side: I never saw Frank alive and I didn’t see the body before Charlie reported — I was arriving into Oxygen for my task as the report happened.

My confirmed route was electrical → security → navigation → storage → lower engine → upper engine → Oxygen. The main person I saw repeatedly was Charlie: I saw him come from weapons into security early, then security to navigation, then navigation to storage, then with me in lower engine, and he left lower engine toward upper engine just ahead of me.

So yes, I was near the body at the end, but Charlie was also right there and slightly ahead of me. I don’t think that proves Charlie either, because he reported and the body may have been old from Bob’s timing. The kill window is too wide, and nobody has a hard contradiction.

I’m voting skip. Next round I think we should pair up and keep close track of Charlie, Bob, and me since we’re the ones connected to Oxygen timing.
